title: 第7章 奶里有毒第8章 惊现小黄人
slug: 未婚当奶娘可她婴语满级啊
content_zh:
苏念禾在厢房里稍作休息，就有丫鬟来叩门：“苏奶娘，少夫人有请。”
“好，有劳姐姐带路。”
苏念禾人美嘴甜，又没有因为有喂奶首功恃宠而骄，倒是让接触过的人不反感。
丫鬟将苏念禾带到门前后，就弓着身退下了。
三等丫鬟进不了屋。
是火夏出来，将她带进屋的。
新生产妇怕吹风，屋门紧闭，里面还有一点淡淡的血腥气。
此时此刻，少夫人雯婧正靠着华丽的靠垫，头带抹额，强打精神坐在床边。
虽然她不施粉黛，素面朝天，头发也散着，却丝毫不影响她的花容月貌。
鹅蛋脸，柳叶眉，妥妥的古典大美女！
苏念禾差点看愣了。
雯婧是尚书之女，在闺阁时就有端庄温婉的贤名，看到苏念禾有些失态，也不怪罪，语气温柔。
“怎的？我这幅模样，可是吓到你了？”她用手摸了摸自己憔悴的脸。
苏念禾赶紧低头福身：“清水出芙蓉，天然去雕饰，原以为小公子就是极漂亮的人了，现在才知，原来是子肖母……”
苏念禾一丝不苟，说得十分真诚。
少夫人雯婧抿嘴笑了：“倒是个嘴甜的。”
但她心里喜滋滋的，露出骄傲的小表情。
哪个母亲不喜欢听别人夸奖自己的孩子？
当然，更愿意听夸自己！
似乎在说，看吧，还得是我，才能生出这么好看的儿子！

若是旁人夸她，她只觉得是恭维。
可眼前这个小姑娘，涉世未深，声音干净，心思纯粹，是不会骗她的。
所以她听着高兴。
再看看，这么单薄、瘦弱的一个小姑娘，竟能搞定整日哭闹的小洲洲。
细想一下，若不是她家里弟、妹众多，把弟弟妹妹一个一个拉扯大，哪能有这样的经验？
不由地心生怜悯：“苏奶娘，吃了不少苦吧？”
苦？
前世她事业有成，生活无忧，日子过的丰富多彩，没苦过。
现在呢，原主的苦日子她是一天没过过，刚来就得了100两的赏赐，还有个顶漂亮的小公子来玩……
不是，来带……
没有比无痛当妈更开心的事了！
况且她有预感，手握利器，未来的生活也会越来越好。
苦，不存在！
苏念禾微笑回话：“遇到贵人，以后的日子会越来越甜。”
她不知道，雯婧才是把她当作贵人！
虽有母爱光环、亲娘滤镜，可架不住小洲洲一直哭啊！
她们不知道孩子怎么回事，只能干着急。
人都要疯魔了。
苏念禾刚一来，就让小洲洲不哭了，睡了觉，还破天荒的喝了奶。
要不是碍于身份，她都想给苏念禾供起来。
content_en:
Su Nianhe was resting in the side room for a while, when a maid came and knocked on the door: "Nanny Su, the young lady has invited you."
"Okay, I'll help you, sister, to lead the way."
Su Nianhe had a sweet mouth and was not arrogant because she was the first to breastfeed. However, people who came into contact with her did not dislike her.
The maid brought Su Nianhe to the door and then bowed back.
The third-class maids could not enter the house.
It was Huo Xia who came out and brought her into the house.
The new mother is afraid of the wind, so the door of the house is closed tightly, and there is still a faint smell of blood inside.
At this moment, the young lady Wenjing was sitting on the edge of the bed, leaning on the gorgeous cushions, wiping her forehead with her headband.
Although she did not apply makeup, kept her face bare and her hair loose, it did not affect her beauty at all.
Oval face, willow eyebrows, a perfect classic beauty!
Su Nianhe was almost stunned.
Wenjing was the daughter of a minister, and had a reputation for being dignified and gentle when she was in the boudoir. When she saw that Su Nianhe was a little rude, she didn't blame her and spoke in a gentle tone.
"What's the matter? Does my appearance scare you?" She touched her haggard face with her hand.
Su Nianhe quickly lowered his head and blessed himself: "Hibiscus emerges from the clear water, and the natural carvings are removed. I thought that the young master was a very beautiful person, but now I know that he is actually Zi Xiao's mother..."
Su Nianhe was meticulous and spoke very sincerely.
The young lady Wenjing pursed her lips and smiled: "She has a sweet mouth."
But she was happy in her heart and showed a proud expression.
What mother doesn't like to hear other people praise her child?
Of course, I would rather hear praise for myself!
It seems to be saying, look, it has to be me to give birth to such a good-looking son!
If others praise her, she only thinks it is a compliment.
But the little girl in front of her was new to the world, had a clean voice, and had a pure mind. She would not lie to her.
So she sounded happy.
Look again, such a thin and frail little girl can actually handle Xiao Zhouzhou who cries all day long.
Think about it carefully, if she didn't have many younger brothers and sisters in her family, and she brought up the younger brothers and sisters one by one, how could she have such an experience?
He couldn't help but feel pity in his heart: "Nanny Su, you have suffered a lot, haven't you?"
Bitter?
In her previous life, she had a successful career and a worry-free life. Her life was colorful and never miserable.
Now, she has never lived a single day of the original owner's hard life. She received a reward of 100 taels when she first came here, and also had a very beautiful young man to play with...
No, come and bring...
There is nothing happier than being a painless mother!
Besides, she had a hunch that with sharp weapons in hand, her life would get better and better in the future.
Bitterness does not exist!
Su Nianhe smiled and replied: "When you meet a noble person, your days will become sweeter and sweeter."
She didn't know that Wenjing was the one who regarded her as a noble person!
Although she has the aura of maternal love and the filter of being a mother, she can't help Xiao Zhouzhou crying all the time!
They don't know what's going on with the child, so they can only worry.
People are going crazy.
As soon as Su Nianhe arrived, Xiao Zhouzhou stopped crying, fell asleep, and drank milk for the first time.
If it weren't for her status, she would have wanted to offer it to Su Nianhe.
